Music Sync Web optional MP3 encoder

Component: @breezystack/lamejs 1.2.7, a JavaScript port of LAME.
Upstream: https://github.com/gideonstele/lamejs
LAME: https://lame.sourceforge.io/
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@breezystack/lamejs/v/1.2.7
License: GNU Lesser General Public License version 3 (LGPL-3.0),
which incorporates GNU General Public License version 3 (GPL-3.0).
Both full license texts and the upstream license notice are included here.

lamejs.js is copied byte-for-byte from the package's dist/lamejs.js.
The encoder remains a separate, replaceable ES module; Music Sync's own code
imports it at runtime only when MP3 is requested. It is not part of Music Sync
Core or a compiled bundle of application code. Replace this file with an
interface-compatible Mp3Encoder implementation to use a modified encoder.
Music Sync does not prevent reverse engineering for debugging modifications
to this LGPL-covered component.

Corresponding source: lamejs-1.2.7-source.tar.gz in this directory.
The npm package identifies Git commit:
1fb0ef5fa177413107e2e107d054a9b994e3f79c
Source archive URL:
https://codeload.github.com/gideonstele/lamejs/tar.gz/1fb0ef5fa177413107e2e107d054a9b994e3f79c
The archive includes upstream source and build configuration. No changes have
been made to this encoder by Music Sync contributors. The npm dependency is
pinned for reproducible development; browser users receive the separate file.

These license terms apply to the encoder, not to audio created with it.
Music Sync's independently authored application/Core code retains its MIT license.
